on Tuesday it reported preliminary Q3 2026 net operating revenue of approximately $158.4M, up from $153.7M a year earlier.
Earnings from operations are estimated at $20.7M, compared with $17.1M in Q3 2025.
Cash and cash equivalents totaled approximately $60.2M as of September 30, 2026, excluding $3.4M held for sale in Canada.

The company will restate its 2024 and 2025 financial statements, along with Q1 and Q2 2026 results, due to an accounting error involving its interest in Smooth Bourbon LLC, which owns the real estate underlying Nugget Casino Resort.
The company warned investors not to rely on the affected financial statements and expects to report at least one additional material weakness in internal controls.
